title: plan.jsonl row
description: Single experiment entry in plan.jsonl. One JSON object per line. Each experiment independently starts a server, runs one bench_cmd, and shuts down.

experiment_id.description: Unique, monotonically assigned at plan generation time.

serve_cmd.description: Full shell command to start the SGLang server (run via SSH, backgrounded by runner).

bench_cmd.description: Full shell command to run the benchmark.

dependencies.description: experiment_ids that must complete before this one. Usually empty — experiments on the same EC2 are serialized by the runner due to port/GPU contention, not by plan deps.

output_file.description: Path where the experiment's result JSON is written (relative to results dir).

server_config_id.description: Stable id for a unique server flag combination. Shared across experiments that only differ in dataset/concurrency.

dataset.description: Dataset slice (kind + resolved fields) for this experiment.
